meta_description:
2,932 likes, 63 comments - ilunarang on December 29, 2025: "Follow for road trip and travel content ✅✅

I had a lot of people tell me "women can't drive" or "women can't drive well" and it's sad how many women quit or never even start because people around them are not supportive.

I made my own money, got my own car and then learned how to drive. It's the best skill you can learn for yourself. Don't worry about making mistakes. It takes time and you might knock it a few times lol but so do men! That's just part of the process.

My husband has been the biggest support for me to be able to drive with confidence on highways and mountains. We have done 2 major road trips:
1. Madhya Pradesh to Ladakh (Ladakh road trip 🏔️ )
2. Madhya Pradesh to Nepal (India to Nepal🇳🇵 road trip)

I really hope you learn how to drive this year! Rooting for my girlies ❤️

#womendriving #indiangirlstravel #indiangirlswander #ladakhroadtrip #indiatonepal
